newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS - Australian Finance Dept corrects Sept deficit.
newsitem.headline: RTRS - Australian Finance Dept corrects Sept deficit.

text.p: The Australian Finance Department issued a corrigendum on Wednesday correcting its September issue of the Commonwealth Government Statement of Financial Transactions.
The corrected statement shows the September monthly underlying fiscal deficit at A$400 million, a $5.9 billion improvement on the originally reported A$6.3 billion.
The error arose from mistaken adjustment of the headline budget balance for the effect of an asset sale.
The cumulative deficit was A$5.864 billion against A$5.533 billion a year earlier.
